stances_toward.note: Each side seeks the other's end, so the ontology's mortal-enemy grade applies. Burhan rejects any truce that leaves the militia in place (the Quad text of Nov 2025 'the worst yet'), urged the UN in 2023 to declare the RSF a terrorist organisation and wrote in 2026 that pauses only let it regroup; the RSF built its own state (Government of Peace and Unity, announced 15 Apr 2025, seat Nyala) and Hemedti told his troops, as Reuters reported on 22 Sept 2026, that 'it's time for the rifles to speak'. The RSF's acceptance of a humanitarian truce (6 Nov 2025) was a tactical move, not a change of aim. Bond grievance: the RSF is the state's own creation (Janjaweed reorganised in 2013, an independent force by law in 2017), a betrayal wound, not a kin tie.
